hypothesis: The 15 unordered pairs in the immediately preceding main-number draw may provide distinct conditional contexts for estimating each candidate number's inclusion probability in the next main draw. A single fixed pair-context estimator may improve a deterministic three-line disjoint union18 portfolio over the exact geometry-matched null.

feature_definition.source: The immediately preceding draw's six main numbers only; bonus numbers are excluded.
feature_definition.contexts: All 15 unordered two-number pairs from the preceding draw.
feature_definition.candidate_universe: All numbers 1..45 are scored for each target.
feature_definition.transition_history: For each historical transition u=2..t-1, the 15 pairs in draw u-1 are contexts and the six main numbers in draw u are binary inclusion outcomes.

source_data_hash_scope_note: Raw canonical lotto_data.csv bytes; exactly 1,250 non-empty records, contiguous rounds 1..1250. The current file hash equals the frozen 1..1250 prefix hash.
training_cutoff_rule: For target t, use only main draws 1..t-1. Historical transitions u=2..t-1 use draw u-1 as the pair context and draw u as the outcome. The target context is the 15 pairs in draw t-1. Add draw t to the transition counts only after scoring target t.

estimator.prior_mean: 6/45 main-number inclusion probability under the uniform 6-of-45 null
estimator.conditional_exposure: For each historical transition and each of the 15 pairs in the previous draw, increment exposure e[pair] once.
estimator.conditional_success: For each exposed pair and each candidate number n, increment s[pair,n] when n is in the following draw's six main numbers.
estimator.candidate_score: For target t, average the posterior_probability over the 15 unordered pairs in draw t-1 for each candidate n.

portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.
portfolio.selection: Reuse the unchanged E045 choose_disjoint_ticket selector. For each line, rank remaining numbers by pair-context score descending, then lower number; take the top 16 as the candidate pool and choose the six-number subset maximizing the frozen E045 structure objective.
portfolio.line_order: Three sequential disjoint selections using the same fixed score and selector; no random selection.

random_comparator.method: For each target, uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line-incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null.

prospective_confirmation.readiness_rule: Even if the historical gate passes, do not create STRICT_PASS_READY or release purchase lines until the policy owner formally predeclares the prospective minimum target count and completion rule.

promotion_rule: Evaluate this single preregistered axis once. No variants, threshold changes, or parameter search after observing results. Historical failure remains failure. Historical pass alone cannot create purchase readiness because prospective confirmation is required and currently unspecified.
